dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: This is a key site of the Kanjou Commission, the center of management for all of Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: If there is something you want to see the Clan Head for... I'm afraid you have come at a bad time.

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: No one can see the Clan Head before Her Excellency the Ogosho makes a judgment.
